newsitem.title: USA: Vistana to acquire Success & Points for $35.6 million.
newsitem.headline: Vistana to acquire Success & Points for $35.6 million.

text.p: Vistana Inc. said Monday that it has a definitive agreement to acquire privately-held Success Cos. & Points, a Colorado-based developer of vacation ownership resort properties, for about $35.6 million.
The company said the acquisition includes about $24.0 million in cash plus 640,000 of Vistana common stock.
The stock portion of the deal is worth about $11.52 million, based on late Monday's price of $18 a share on Nasdaq, down 12.5 cents from Friday.
Success & Points has one vacation ownership resort in Arizona and two in Colorado.
The deal is expected to close by the end of September.
